title: Baby in Wicker Carriage, Parents Shadows - Vintage 1930s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A high-angle outdoor snapshot of an eight-week-old baby resting wrapped in blankets inside a vintage wicker baby carriage or pram. On the grass behind the buggy, the distinct shadows of two adults—one holding a box camera at waist height—are cast by the bright sunlight, capturing a tender candid moment of early parenthood in the mid-20th century.
